findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "pitchsparkMcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pitchspark_find_startup_pitches_v1, pitchspark_startup_pitch_details_v1, search_pitches · Private data: pitchspark_find_startup_pitches_v1, pitchspark_startup_pitch_details_v1, pitchspark_health_v1, search_pitches · Public sink: pitchspark_find_startup_pitches_v1, pitchspark_startup_pitch_details_v1 · Destructive: pitchspark_find_startup_pitches_v1, pitchspark_startup_pitch_details_v1.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pitchspark_find_startup_pitches_v1, pitchspark_startup_pitch_details_v1, search_pitches · Private data: pitchspark_find_startup_pitches_v1, pitchspark_startup_pitch_details_v1, pitchspark_health_v1, search_pitches · Public sink: pitchspark_find_startup_pitches_v1, pitchspark_startup_pitch_details_v1 · Destructive: pitchspark_find_startup_pitches_v1, pitchspark_startup_pitch_details_v1

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
